'''Gilles George Cloutier''', {{Post-nominals|country=CAN|CC|OQ|FRSC}} (June 27, 1928 – May 13, 2014) was a [[Canadians|Canadian]] [[physicist]] and former director of the [[Alberta Research Council]].<ref>[http://necrologie.lapresse.ca/resultatrecherche.php?nodef=3505559 Gilles Cloutier]</ref>

==Early life and education==

Born in [[Quebec City]], he was educated at [[Université Laval]] and [[McGill University]].

==Career==

He was rector of the [[Université de Montréal]] from 1985 to 1993.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.985fm.ca/national/nouvelles/l-ex-recteur-de-l-universite-de-montreal-gilles-g.-319447.html |title=L'ex-recteur de l'Université de Montréal, Gilles G. Cloutier, meurt à 85 ans |publisher=985fm.ca |date=2010-06-01 |accessdate=2014-05-16 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20140517115814/http://www.985fm.ca/national/nouvelles/l-ex-recteur-de-l-universite-de-montreal-gilles-g.-319447.html |archivedate=2014-05-17 }}</ref>

He died in 2014 at the age of 85.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.985fm.ca/national/nouvelles/l-ex-recteur-de-l-universite-de-montreal-gilles-g.-319447.html |title=L'Ex-recteur de l'Université de Montréal, Gilles G. Cloutier, meurt à 85 ans • National • 98,5 fm Montréal |accessdate=2014-05-16 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20140517115814/http://www.985fm.ca/national/nouvelles/l-ex-recteur-de-l-universite-de-montreal-gilles-g.-319447.html |archivedate=2014-05-17 }}</ref>

==Honours==
* In 1976, he was made a Fellow of the [[Royal Society of Canada]]. 
* In 1981, he made an Officer of the [[Order of Canada]].
* In 1983, he was awarded an honorary Doctor of Science from the [[University of Alberta]].
* In 1989, he was made an Officer of the [[National Order of Quebec]].
* In 1993, he was promoted to Companion of the Order of Canada.
* He was appointed to the Canada Foundation for Innovation.
